title: Identify the Real Problem
hook: Your sales problem is probably an offer problem. Training won't fix that.
statement: Most failures come from solving the wrong problem.
explainer: Symptoms are loud. Fix one and it comes back. Dig for the cause.
sop: Write the problem as you see it.
Score Real Problem and Symptom Confusion 1 to 10.
equation_example: Real Problem 3 ÷ Symptom Confusion 8 = 0.375. Well under 1. You're treating a symptom.
question: Pick one problem. Ask why five times, in writing.
closing_statement: The symptom is a clue, not the cause.
